name: chatgpt-plugin-creator
description: Create task-specific ChatGPT plugin archives from a purpose and intended use cases, with source files and validation guidance.

interface.longDescription: Describe the purpose and intended use cases. This skill authors plugin instructions, resources and archive files where the host provides file-generation tools. It includes validation and packaging helpers, but does not itself grant code execution, hosting, authentication or publishing permissions.
defaultPrompt: Create a plugin from this purpose and these intended use cases.
